text:
A type of
Modelled Process
with an associated
Executable
where
reportingBehavior
is set to
doesNotReportExecu-
tionState
([TPS_MANI_01279]). Please note that the
Non-
reporting Process
was
not
developed for the
AUTOSAR Adap-
tive Platform
and for this reason it is not using
Adaptive
Platform Services
. For example, it is not using
ara::
exec::ExecutionClient
API and therefore cannot report
Ex-
ecution State
to
Execution Management
. In general, this
type of a process is intended to allow integration of a software
that cannot be modified for use with the
AUTOSAR Adaptive
Platform
.
